title: Law to improve data on gender-based violence
summary: This bill would require the Mayor's Office to End Gender-Based Violence, with the health department, to review existing data on gender-based violence and report recommendations for better data collection within one year. It would also require an outreach program surveying healthcare providers' screening practices, a public data dashboard combining city and state information, and reporting by the Department of Homeless Services and Administration for Children's Services on their own gender-based violence screenings.
